Supposedly bookmarked by 99% of PhD students.

## Websites {#网站}

- XJTLU website directory: <https://guide.xjtlu.edu.cn>

- Personal information portal, ebridge: <https://ebridge.xjtlu.edu.cn>

- University of Liverpool portal, Liverpool Life: <https://liverpool-life.liverpool.ac.uk>

## WeChat official accounts {#公众号}

| University | Library | Student services (One Stop) | IT |
|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|
| ![University WeChat account QR code](../../../assets/imported/Kai.Wu/qrcode_XJTLU-China_1.jpg){width=110px} | ![Library WeChat account QR code](../../../assets/imported/Kai.Wu/qrcode_XJTLU_library_1.jpg){width=110px} | ![Student services QR code](../../../assets/imported/Kai.Wu/qrcode_student_service.jpg){width=110px} | ![IT QR code](../../../assets/imported/Kai.Wu/qrcode_IT.jpg){width=110px} |

Schools may also have official accounts. Search WeChat for "西浦" or "西交利物浦" followed by the school's name.

## Mobile app {#手机app}

<https://guide.xjtlu.edu.cn/How-to-install-the-XJTLU-APP.html>

## Where to find frequently used resources {#常用资源位置}

- XJTLU PGR Handbook, University policies and regulations: log in to ebridge and find "PGR Policies, Procedures and Forms" in the centre of the page.

- University of Liverpool PGR Handbook: <https://www.liverpool.ac.uk/student-administration/research-students/pgr-handbook/>

- Campus map: see [Campus map](../appendix/campus-map.qmd#xp-guide-campus-map) in the appendix, or search WeChat for the "西浦地图" mini program.

- Academic calendar: after logging in to ebridge, select "Academic Calendar" on the left.

- Useful phone numbers: see [University contacts](../appendix/contacts.qmd#xp-guide-contacts) in the appendix.

:::
